allowed_changes: at the first execution session of each new month, independently test each of gold_cny, Nasdaq, S&P 500, CSI300 and Shanghai Composite
for each asset, use the latest completed month-end price and the simple average of exactly the latest ten completed month-end prices
invest exactly 20% portfolio weight in a sleeve only when latest month-end price is strictly greater than its own 10-month average; otherwise that 20% remains CNY cash
review monthly using only T-1 completed observations
one annually rebalanced 20% each five-asset control and one CNY cash control
use product-level 1.00% fee plus 0.05% slippage with no sensitivity grid
comparison_gates: CAGR > annually rebalanced equal-weight five-asset control
Sharpe > annually rebalanced equal-weight five-asset control
MDD <= annually rebalanced equal-weight five-asset control
expected_outputs: Faber GTAA, annually equal and cash portfolio CSVs
actual trade count, active-by-month audit, average cash, realized max gross, minimum cash and target fingerprint
global post-protocol DSR after the formal run
run authorization, execution commit and SHA artifact manifest
follow_up_policy: After any formal performance metric is viewed, do not change the 10-month rule, month-end sampling, sleeve weight, asset set, fee/slippage, or add a trend buffer/confirmation in this lineage. Any alternative trend horizon or allocation is a separate preregistered architecture, not rescue tuning.
forbidden_changes: daily instead of month-end signal sampling
relative ranking, winner selection, Top-N, momentum weighting or inverse-volatility sizing
changing fixed 20% sleeve weights or dropping any asset after results
adding VIX, NFCI, Sahm, yield curve, credit, volatility, drawdown or momentum confirmation
adding hysteresis, buffer bands, minimum persistence days or delayed exits
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage, gross exposure above 100% or negative cash
hypothesis: A simple asset-by-asset long-term trend filter can reduce exposure during persistent bear markets without forecasting the relative winner. At each month boundary, independently investing each fixed 20% sleeve only when the asset latest completed month-end CNY price is above its own 10-month moving average should preserve diversified risk-premium participation while moving broken-trend sleeves to cash, with low enough turnover to remain viable under the product-level fee.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: Mebane T. Faber, A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation; fixed monthly 10-month simple moving-average timing applied uniformly across asset classes
selection_metric: No parameter selection. Exactly one literature-motivated 10-month monthly absolute-trend rule, five fixed 20% sleeves. Validation, objective and annual-equal comparison are independent ATM-SVP-3 axes.

shared_rules.review: first execution session of each new calendar month
shared_rules.trend_operator: latest completed month-end price > average of latest ten completed month-end prices
